A '''Zabrak Dark Jedi''' who was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] eventually turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] at some point.<ref name="STJM" /> At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="Note">The ''[[Squadrons Over Corellia]]'' expansion set of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' is set during the timeframe of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]], which takes place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].</ref> they engaged at least three [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]], using her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to fight the [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. During the skirmish, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] executed a 360-degree spin (''[[jung ma]]'') and bisected (''[[Sai tok/Legends|sai tok]]'') the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] horizontally. They were pale-skinned and had [[Color/Legends|red]], flowing [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. The [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] wore a [[Cape/Legends|cape]] and red-colored [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]], and used a [[Curved-hilt lightsaber/Legends|curved-hilt lightsaber]] with a red [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]].<ref name="STJM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Zabrak Dark Jedi was depicted on the card "Sai Tok Jung Ma" from the ''[[Squadrons Over Corellia]]'' expansion set of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'',<ref name="STJM" /> released in [[2008]].<ref name="STJM date">{{SWArchive|url=games/videogames/news20081216.html|text=Man Your Ship! ''Star Wars'' Galaxies TCG Expansion}}</ref> The Dark Jedi was drawn by [[Mark Evans (artist)|Mark Evans]].<ref name="Evans">{{WebCite|url=https://www.cloudmover.net/gamecards/slideshow1/starwars.html|text=Star Wars Galaxies|author=Mark Evans|archivedate=20190127071029}}</ref>
